"Implement Edit Course (CU-CONT-02 / HU-08 CA5) at PATCH /api/learning/courses/{id}. 2. Database (`db/queries/courses.sql` + `sqlc generate`): add `GetCourseByID` and `UpdateCourse` queries against `courses` (`id`, `teacher_id`, `title`, `description`, `cefr_level`, `cover_url`, `status`, `created_at`) and run `sqlc generate`.
3. SQLite Adapter (`internal/adapter/sqlite/course_store.go`): implement `GetByID(ctx, courseID) (domain.Course, error)` (mapping `sql.ErrNoRows` to `domain.ErrNotFound`) and `Update(ctx, domain.Course) (domain.Course, error)`.
4. Use Case (`internal/usecase/update_course.go`): implement `UpdateCourseUseCase.Execute(ctx, UpdateCourseCommand{CourseID, TeacherID, Title, Description, CEFRLevel, CoverURL}) (domain.Course, error)` loading the existing course via a consumer-defined `CourseRepository` interface, verifying `course.TeacherID == cmd.TeacherID` (returning `domain.ErrForbidden` on mismatch), applying provided partial field updates, validating the resulting `domain.Course`, and persisting it.

   - Register `PATCH /api/learning/courses/{id}` under `Authenticate` + `RequireRole("TEACHER")` + `RequireCourseOwner`, returning `200 OK` with `{"id", "teacherId", "title", "description", "cefrLevel", "coverUrl", "status", "createdAt"}`.
   - Map `ErrNotFound` -> `404`, `ErrForbidden` -> `403`, `ErrValidation` -> `422`, and malformed JSON -> `400` via `respondError`.
   - Update `shared/contracts/learning-api.yaml` (and `contracts/learning.openapi.yaml`); wire `UpdateCourseUseCase` and `RequireCourseOwner` in `cmd/api/main.go`.
6. Tests (stdlib `testing`): add table-driven unit tests for `UpdateCourseUseCase` (partial updates, non-owner forbidden, not found, validation errors), `:memory:` SQLite integration tests for `GetByID` and `Update`, and `httptest` handler tests covering `200`, `400`, `401`, `403` (both non-`TEACHER` role and non-owner `TEACHER`), `404`, and `422`.
